_how: Natural sound effects copied from Downloads/music (peak-normalised to -1 dB). gain = suggested dB under the voice. Use 2-5 per Short, only where the picture shows the sound happening, never as decoration. Gains were raised 4 dB on 2026-10-01 after measuring: at the old values the effects added under 1 dB and were inaudible under the voice.

swish.use: a made shot you can SEE go through the net (free throws, threes)

rim.use: a miss that clanks off the rim on screen

brick.use: an ugly miss / airball reaction (thump + rim ring)

whistle.use: a referee whistle on screen: foul, free throw, stoppage

horn.use: end of game / buzzer beater / shot clock moment

dribble.use: under a close-up of a player dribbling

whoosh.use: a fast push-in or a jump to a screenshot/graphic (soft)

whoosh_long.use: bigger scene change, e.g. into the payoff line

boom_cinematic.use: the one big reveal of the Short (low, felt more than heard)

boom.use: hard impact on a stat reveal - strong, use at most once

riser.use: tension building into a reveal (ends right on the reveal word)

heartbeat.use: suspense under a clutch moment (free throw with the game on the line)

camera.use: press conference, signing, photo shoot, jersey reveal

click.use: a screenshot appearing (Basketball Reference, ESPN, Spotrac)

ding.use: a single key fact landing - rarely

cha_ching.use: money - only if the picture is a contract/salary graphic

surprise.use: shock beat ('until Victor Wembanyama') - once at most

pop.use: tiny accent when a highlight box appears

punch.use: a physical hit on screen (hard foul, block)

ankle_breaker.use: only a real ankle-breaking crossover on screen
